name: design-guard
description: Enforce a project's design system instead of hoping the agent remembers it. Maps a file path to the design system that governs it, then checks palette drift, emoji in the UI, type below the size floor, Thai text set too small, hard-coded colours inside dark-mode blocks, pill radii where the system wants square badges, missing prefers-reduced-motion and wrong font stacks. Rules live in an editable JSON file.
